entries.en: A name opens.
A bond sustains.
A price closes.
No... wait. Not yet.
Huh...? What the hell was that?
I was doing something. I was, right? Tell me I was.
My bed... my desk... my usual mess.
Hold up. The window wasn't on that side. Who rearranged my house?
Hello? Anybody home?
Why am I waiting for an answer? I live alone, genius.
No. Something is seriously messed up here.
Okay. Figure out where you are first. Freak out later. Pencil it in.
Bed — The pillow is cold on one side and creased on the other.
Yeah, going back to sleep won't fix this. Tempting, though.
Window — There is light outside, but no recognizable landscape.
I know this view... no. I do know it. That's creepy.
Photograph — The shape of the figures is preserved; one detail won't settle in memory.
Huh. This photo wasn't like this. Photos don't do that, right?
Poe's familiar object — Small, worn at the points where fingers would touch it.
Poe would knock this off in two seconds. While looking me dead in the eye.
Would...? Why did I say it like that?
Easy. I don't even know what happened. No drama yet.
Writing desk — Scribbled pages, all in the same handwriting as hers.
That's my handwriting. I just don't remember writing any of it. Great start.
This book is mine. So who wrote half of this? Drunk me?
Do not mistake memory for proof.
I wrote this? Seriously?
Wait. The photo changed. Again.
I saw it. I'm sure. I'm not crazy.
...Or I thought I was. Who knows anymore.
I'll write it down before it changes again. Including what I remember. Which isn't much.
The circle is whole... and it doesn't work. Classic.
The window's open. Wonderful. The wind will blow out every candle.
There. Window shut. One thing solved, only everything left.
And the anchor's out of place. It goes in the center.
Moon: recognize the phase. Book: fix the record. Memory: do not mistake it for image. Rest: hold the threshold.
Moon, Book, Memory, Rest. Okay. Let's do this.
One lit! Look at that, I know what I'm doing. Probably.
Oh, no. Wrong order. At least only the candles went out, not me.
Done. But... hold on. This doesn't feel like the start of a ritual.
Feels like I'm finishing something I already did. Love that for me.
If this ritual brought me here, it can take me back. It's the least it can do.
Yeah. Just hope I don't wake up in an even worse room. Like one with no window.
Okay. Definitely not in my room anymore. Or my zip code.
This mark... it's the same as the circle's.
So it was the ritual. Congrats, me.
Okay, but... why did I do it? Who let me?
The path remembers the hand that opened it.
Great. Even the wall knows more than I do.
Hello? Anyone there? Preferably someone with answers?
A room this big and... nothing? What a waste.
There is an outline shielded from the dust. Whatever occupied it was taken away.
Wait. Something was here. Someone took it.
Judging by the mark, it wasn't anything small.
Who goes to all this trouble to leave a room empty? That's a lot of minimalism.
Along the baseboard, a delicate mark repeats a sign seen in the Bedroom.
What remains of an image when it does not show who should be in it?
The shape. The image still exists, even with someone missing.
And what did you do when the call brought no answer?
I kept calling. I remember that.
Why did you return to this place?
I opened the way. That part, at least, I know.
Wait, is this echo correcting me? The nerve.
No... Wait. Poe? Is that really you?
You picked the worst possible time to show up, you know that? Typical.
...Wow. It's so good to see you.
Okay. Questions later. C'mere, you dork.
It's this door. Sure of it. Mostly.
Huh? Back in the same place? You've got to be kidding me.
No, hold on. The mark was on the other side.
What returns does not always come back the same.
Two marks don't match. That's the way in.
Ah. The door lies. Look at what changed. Sneaky little door.
The name was written while the flame was low.
Someone crossed before the door existed.
You called and heard no answer.
I said I would not call again.
That last voice...
It's me. That voice is mine.
But I never said I'd stop. I remember keeping on. Stubborn as ever.
That voice sounds like mine... but I do not remember saying those words.
If that was me talking, why don't I remember any of it? How convenient.
No sky... and everything still casts a shadow. Makes total sense. Not.
Three bases turn. Each groove points to a fragment of the same design.
No point looking for the light source. This place doesn't care about physics.
If I line up the shadows, maybe something shows up.
Nope, not that side.
Look! The three make a star! Take that, labyrinth.
What opens does not sustain. What sustains does not close.
Three different parts. Mix up the order and it goes south.
Name opens.
Bond sustains.
Price closes.
Seven paths... Do I know these symbols? I think I do. Unfortunately.
Is it just me, or is this place testing me? Because I didn't study.
You opened the Core. But something is still missing.
Oh, great. Someone else popping out of nowhere.
At least this time you have questions.
Who are you? And what is this place? The short version, please.
Do you really want to start there?
I'd like to start with an answer. Any answer. I'm not picky.
Then let's take the most useful one: you opened the way here.
And the Moon? What happens if I go in? Skip the riddles, ideally.
You'll find things you forgot. Not all of them are yours.
And be careful with what you decide to keep.
I've passed this door before. It was closed. Now it's not. Totally normal.
There is no shortage of doors. What remains is to finish what was opened.
Still missing marks. Better go back.
Echoes, the door, the voices, the shadows... the Core. Done and done.
The Moon opened. Guess that's where I'm headed next.
Wow... This is way different from the Labyrinth. Prettier, at least.
What shows does not promise to keep.
So not everything I see here can be trusted. Shocking. Nobody saw that coming.
What, Poe? This outfit's weird to me too. I didn't pick it.
Come on. Let's take it slow, okay?
Oh, of course. The flowers are right in the middle of the lake. Why wouldn't they be?
And no dry path. Perfect. Love it.
Brr... freezing. But it doesn't look deep.
Poe, stay here. Be right back, okay? Don't vanish.
You can stop watching me. I'm not going to vanish... I think.
Distance keeps what the hasty hand loses.
Waxing... Maybe I'm getting too close?
Poe, wait there. I'll try from here.
It worked... from a distance. Noted.
Two images only touch when they look at the same place.
What if I stand where the reflection is?
Remove what is left over. Do not add what is missing.
Waning. Less, then.
Yes! All three! Now open, please. I'm asking nicely.
Seven mirrors? Seriously? One was already too many.
A gesture ends an instant after it begins.
This one's running a little late. Like me in the morning.
A gesture begins before it is thought.
And this one moves before I do. Rude.
There is a room; there is no one inside it.
Wait... there's the room. But it's empty.
So it's a sequence. Late, early... the room.
Why is the reflection doing that? Stop it.
Better not get too close. In case it grabs me.
One version of Melantha does not move, even when she changes places.
This one doesn't move. Not even when I do. Lazy.
The reflection only shows things after Melantha looks away.
This one only shows what I did after I walk away. Gossip.
The reflected hand switches sides, but keeps the same scar.
My hand is flipped... but the scar's still there.
The glass shows the shadow of someone who never entered the room.
There's a shadow in there. Whose, if nobody came in? Don't like that.
No. I can't forget this too.
If I can just remember the name... a little longer...
I was holding something.
Or someone... No, I can't see it.
Is this memory mine? I don't even know anymore.
You saw something in the mirror. What do you think it was?
I saw a piece of the ritual. At least I think so.
And you've already decided the memory is yours?
I was there. I saw my own hands.
I didn't ask whether you were there.
Okay, and what's that supposed to mean? In plain words, ideally.
That maybe you're asking the wrong question.
Could you, I don't know, say one thing without making me more confused? Just one.
I could. But would you believe it just because I said it?
Gone again. Of course. He does love a dramatic exit.
...And now I have more questions than before. Thanks a lot.
The clearest passage is always the true one.
Always? Oh, sure. This place has to be trolling me.
The sign points left... but the floor looks different.
I'll follow the mark on the floor. The sign can deal with it.
Damn. Back to the start. Love it.
Okay, check the mark first. Then choose. It's not hard, Melantha.
Yes! The corridor stopped changing. Finally.
Eight doors... and not one looks like an exit. Great.
A mark can outlast its explanation.
Fine. Let's hear what they've got to say.
What remains when the image changes places?
Mark.
What shows without promising to keep?
Reflection.
What decides what was left behind?
Memory.
It opened! Great. Still no clue what this has to do with me.
Three rings... I feel like I've messed with these before. Big surprise.
The phase does not ask for everything.
Waning.
The record is not a person.
Grimoire.
The intention is not to possess.
Sustain.
Waning, Grimoire, Sustain. Done.
Hope that's the right one. At least now I know how I got here.
The mark... the bell... the shadow. All of it again. Encore.
Trace of the mark — the stroke remains even though the hand is gone.
I've seen this stroke before. At the beginning.
Trace of the bell — the last note is missing.
The fourth note. Again.
Trace of the shadow — the outline follows no light.
Okay, this is getting weird even for me. And I'm used to weird.
Poe... you want me to take this?
I don't even know whose it is. But sure.
I felt something. But I couldn't see what.
I think it's the way out. I think.
I still don't get half of what happened. Maybe two thirds.
But I've got the Fragment... and a few free memories.
And you, right? My partner who never explains anything.
All right. Let's go home.
The window...
It's in the right place.
The photo too. Wait...
Did I fall asleep?
No. This came from there.
Then I really was in that place.
The engraved chain imprisons no door. It only shows that two links can choose to stay together.
Is that a chain? Doesn't seem to hold anything. Just for show.
Can't get in this way. Yet.
A crack climbs the wall as if it had decided to fall upward.
This wall's cracked top to bottom. Great craftsmanship.
This way's closed too. Obviously.
The stone was carved to be read from the opposite side.
Wait... the symbol only makes sense seen from the other side.
Can't get through here right now.
An unlit lantern rests where the wall most needs light.
An unlit lantern. Super useful. Thanks.
Not this way either. Of course.
Under the dust is the mark of something that grew where nothing seemed to fit.
Even the stone cracked and something grew. Resilient.
This passage is closed.
Three bell marks, but only one seems to have been rung.
Three bells... and only one rang. Team effort, clearly.
Nope. Better leave this door for later.
The first person to pass left no face: they left a stroke so small it almost became stone.
Such a small mark... and still someone wanted to keep it.
In the second arch, an image repeated the right gesture with the wrong hand. The watcher smiled, relieved, and never noticed the difference.
He didn't even notice the picture was wrong. Classic.
A voice arrived before the person who was meant to speak it. When the person appeared, they did not recognize their own words.
This... why does it feel so familiar?
The room had four walls and one window too many. No one asked where it led.
One window too many? Just like my room... What is it with windows?
A candle stayed lit after everyone agreed it had been put out. The record changed; the flame did not.
The candle still lit... That reminds me of something.
The third toll was heard by everyone; the fourth, only by those waiting for someone.
The fourth toll again. Of course.
A door stayed closed for years. When it finally opened, there was no sign that anyone had ever locked it.
It was closed... but maybe nobody ever locked it.
The last name was written with care. Afterward, the records disagreed about who had spoken it.
The name stayed written. No telling who said it, though.
A muffled bell. The fourth note never sounds.
The circle answers with an incomplete light; an abrupt cut before the outcome.
A floorboard creaks in the distance. No answer.
The correct flame catches and holds a quiet glow.
Lie down and try to cross over? [Lie down] [Not yet]
At last the bell rings, though it seems to come from beneath the floor.
The flame draws back into the sigil. Cut to cold stone.
A faint tapping, like claws against a surface hidden from view.
Nothing answers; the open path remains.
[Presence] [Form] [Certainty]
[I fell silent] [I kept calling] [I forgot the name]
[Because I opened the way] [Because I no longer exist] [Because I was brought here]
The three voices fall silent in reverse order.
A feline silhouette slips between two columns and stops at a distance.
...Poe?
A short meow.
Poe sniffs the outstretched hand, turns his head and sits.
Poe stands and begins to follow her, leaving the passage clear.
The door opens without revealing the other side.
The stone recedes, revealing the true path.
Which voice contradicts your memory? [An unfamiliar voice] [My own voice, saying something I do not remember] [Poe's voice]
Ripples in the well spread away from the centre.
The first obelisk gives a harsh sound; the shadow shifts.
A line of light runs along the floor towards the Core.
The last mark settles into place; seven alcoves light up without unlocking every door.
A compass of light turns against the motion of the rings.
Poe steps forward; Andrealphus inclines his head towards him, offering no explanation.
The silhouette dissolves; the protagonist can move again.
Enter the Moon Domain? [Enter] [Go back]
A luminous ripple travels around the arch; Poe hesitates, then follows.
Poe studies her new clothes before looking down the path.
The protagonist tests the depth; the water reflects the moon before it touches her foot.
A ripple; the water closes behind her.
Poe sits, following her movements with his eyes, and meows when Melantha nears a petal.
Melantha steps away; the petal responds to their relative positions.
Reflection and petal fall into phase.
The three marks glow in sequence; the next passage responds.
Select: DELAYED → AHEAD → BEDROOM.
The surface of the Black Mirror trembles without reflecting the protagonist.
The sound of a candle going out cuts the sentence short.
The mirror shows an empty frame where a reflection should be.
Poe draws close to Melantha; Andrealphus dissolves into dim particles.
A doorframe shifts a shadow; the wrong path returns the player to the marker.
The route stabilises without another teleport.
Poe watches the facade; each door lights briefly as it is read.
MARK → REFLECTION → MEMORY.
The central mechanism responds and opens the way.
One pulse. A second. A third. The sigil forms a complete design.
The Fragment responds as Melantha approaches; Poe looks at her, not at the object.
A sensory memory: warmth, fabric, a small weight in the hand; cut before any name.
Poe sits near the edge of the light.
Return? [Yes] [Not yet]
The portal sounds like a held breath; the screen dissolves.
Distant bells. A bird, for the first time.
Melantha notices a mark left by the Fragment on a physical object.
A small, familiar sound behind the door; the camera does not reveal its source.
...Poe?
Silence. A slow fade to black. Beta credits. Return to the menu.
